Identified Limitation: On entirely novel job categories (unseen JDs), accuracy is 54.46% vs 81.48% on known categories.
Engineering Mitigation: Display continuous ordinal relevance ranking scores rather than hard discrete labels; rank order (71.5% nDCG) remains reliable.

Identified Limitation: Under 512-token context, 93.1% of resumes still exceed length limits (median 1,204 tokens).
Engineering Mitigation: Implemented section-aware multi-chunk mean-pooling (extracting skills, experience, projects separately).

Identified Limitation: No discrete NVIDIA GPU; all deep learning computation runs on 14-thread Intel CPU.
Engineering Mitigation: Precomputed dense embedding caching, allowing deep architecture sweeps to complete in seconds on CPU.

Identified Limitation: Boundary between 'Potential Fit' and adjacent categories accounts for 74% of classification errors.
Engineering Mitigation: Ordinal scoring formula 100*(0.0*P0 + 0.5*P1 + 1.0*P2) smoothly handles threshold ambiguity without sharp penalties.

Identified Limitation: New DenseCrossNet_512 checkpoint is validated in artifacts/ but not yet deployed to live API.
Engineering Mitigation: Preserved production checkpoint safety as mandated; ready for safe zero-downtime deployment.
